_comment: HOOK MODE ONLY -- no arguments. Claude Code delivers the event payload as JSON on STDIN and does NOT expand ${CLAUDE_USER_PROMPT}; that variable does not exist. The earlier registration passed -Route "${CLAUDE_USER_PROMPT}", so the script received an empty route, fell through to waiting on stdin, and HUNG until the harness killed it (measured: exit 124, zero bytes, 'Hook UserPromptSubmit success:' with nothing after the colon). Because it was killed rather than failing, the '|| bash' fallback never ran. Both scripts read the payload themselves and are measured working this way: exit 0, 'RoT MoE :: TIER 1 -> FORGE Claude'. checker/hook-contract.sh executes THESE EXACT command strings and requires real output, so this file can no longer be wrong while every gate is green.
